Unchecked commit reseals an external modification.

SAFE_COMMIT re-tags the current contents after an audited direct modification of the storage (only available with CONFIG_SAFE_DATA_ALLOW_UNCHECKED_COMMIT).

TC_SAFE_DATA_CONCURRENT_ACCESS_IS_SERIAL.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

Concurrent access never yields torn snapshots.

A producer mutating dependent fields under SAFE_UPDATE and a consumer using SAFE_READ run concurrently for many iterations; the consumer never observes a snapshot violating the payload invariant.

**Source:** `main.c (line 495) <../../dox-safe-data-testspec/group__safe__data.html#ga147549439a2551b44676b636c8d1320b>`__
TC_SAFE_DATA_CONCURRENT_ACCESS_IS_SERIAL.title: concurrent access is serialised

TC_SAFE_DATA_DETECTS_CORRUPTION.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

Payload corruption detected; verification is pure.

Out-of-band payload corruption is detected by SAFE_VERIFY without modifying the payload (pure check). With the shadow copy the subsequent locked read repairs and reseals; without it the fault is unrecoverable.

**Source:** `main.c (line 212) <../../dox-safe-data-testspec/group__safe__data.html#ga1aa530087f0fc0668cf846fb41220eb2>`__
TC_SAFE_DATA_DETECTS_CORRUPTION.title: detects corruption

TC_SAFE_DATA_DOUBLE_FAULT_UNRECOVERABLE.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

Double fault is unrecoverable.

Inconsistent corruption of payload AND shadow leaves no copy to vouch for the data: verification reports -EILSEQ.

**Depends on:** ``CONFIG_SAFE_DATA_REDUNDANT``

**Source:** `main.c (line 353) <../../dox-safe-data-testspec/group__safe__data.html#ga2922b4bbaf847eccc26f4732a1836ee8>`__
TC_SAFE_DATA_DOUBLE_FAULT_UNRECOVERABLE.title: double fault unrecoverable

TC_SAFE_DATA_FAULT_HANDLER_EVENTS.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

Registered handler receives all event kinds.

`safe_data_fault_handler_register() <../../dox-safe-data-api/group__safe__data__diag__apis.html#gaf59812adbd045cc7780afb28bb754bf5>`__ accepts one callback (second registration is rejected with -EALREADY, re-registration is idempotent) and the callback receives recovery events as well as unrecoverable faults with a populated event descriptor.

TC_SAFE_DATA_FAULT_HANDLER_EVENTS.title: fault handler events

TC_SAFE_DATA_INIT_AND_VERIFY.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

Init seals and verification passes.

SAFE_INIT seals the freshly written payload; SAFE_VERIFY on the untouched container returns 0.

**Source:** `main.c (line 44) <../../dox-safe-data-testspec/group__safe__data.html#gae55f6906f3e0f23cfce1987b1402dcac>`__
TC_SAFE_DATA_INIT_AND_VERIFY.title: init and verify

TC_SAFE_DATA_LOCK_TIMEOUT_IS_BOUNDED_AND.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

Blocked access fails within the lock bound.

While another thread holds the container lock, an access fails with -ETIMEDOUT within CONFIG_SAFE_DATA_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS and the timeout is counted; the container is usable again after the holder releases.

**Depends on:** ``CONFIG_SAFE_DATA_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS > 0``; ``CONFIG_SAFE_DATA_LOCKING``

**Source:** `main.c (line 772) <../../dox-safe-data-testspec/group__safe__data.html#gada2bf52c35a16ccdbc55a315af0ffde9>`__
TC_SAFE_DATA_LOCK_TIMEOUT_IS_BOUNDED_AND.title: lock timeout is bounded and reported

TC_SAFE_DATA_NULL_ARGS.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

NULL and zero-size arguments are rejected.

Every API entry point rejects missing required pointers and zero-length payloads with -EINVAL (a NULL lock is legal: locking is optional).

**Source:** `main.c (line 384) <../../dox-safe-data-testspec/group__safe__data.html#ga798956ba248b65c68f5d49a0c8d63a0b>`__
TC_SAFE_DATA_NULL_ARGS.title: null args

TC_SAFE_DATA_READ_ROUNDTRIP.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

Read returns the sealed value.

A value written through SAFE_WRITE is returned bit-exact by a validated SAFE_READ.

TC_SAFE_DATA_READ_ROUNDTRIP.title: read roundtrip

TC_SAFE_DATA_SECTION_SCOPE.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

SAFE_SECTION reseals at scope exit.

Modifications made through the typed pointer inside a SAFE_SECTION block are sealed automatically on normal scope exit and visible to the next read.

**Depends on:** ``CONFIG_SAFE_DATA_GNU_EXTENSIONS``

TC_SAFE_DATA_SECTION_SCOPE.title: section scope

Self-test reports a healthy mechanism.

TC_SAFE_DATA_STALE_TAG_RECOVERS.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

Stale tag with consistent data recovers.

When only the stored tag is corrupted (payload and shadow agree), the fault is recoverable; a locked read makes the reseal durable.

Status draft (demonstration of status handling): SD-REQ-009 is also verified by TC_SAFE_DATA_DETECTS_CORRUPTION and TC_SAFE_DATA_VERIFY_REPAIR_FIXES_IN_PLACE. The test still runs.

**Depends on:** ``CONFIG_SAFE_DATA_REDUNDANT``

TC_SAFE_DATA_STATS_COUNT_EVENTS.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

Statistics count every integrity event.

Recovered-payload, recovered-tag and unrecoverable detections each increment their dedicated counter exactly once per detection.

**Depends on:** ``CONFIG_SAFE_DATA_STATS``

**Source:** `main.c (line 555) <../../dox-safe-data-testspec/group__safe__data.html#gae736dcfeadc44bbadef9a8cecb217df9>`__
TC_SAFE_DATA_STATS_COUNT_EVENTS.title: stats count events

TC_SAFE_DATA_UPDATE_ABORT_KEEPS_INTEGRIT.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

Aborted update leaves a consistent container.

A mutator returning a negative errno aborts the transaction. With the redundant shadow the payload is rolled back to the pre-update value; without it the partial write is detectable via the (not resealed) tag.

**Source:** `main.c (line 147) <../../dox-safe-data-testspec/group__safe__data.html#ga8accdf3b41c892d614c2ff40d2cd1b6e>`__
TC_SAFE_DATA_UPDATE_ABORT_KEEPS_INTEGRIT.title: update abort keeps integrity

TC_SAFE_DATA_UPDATE_CLAMPS_POSITIVE_MUTA.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

Positive mutator return is clamped and aborted.

A mutator returning a positive value violates the contract: SAFE_UPDATE returns -EINVAL, the transaction aborts (rollback with shadow), and the violation is counted.

**Source:** `main.c (line 679) <../../dox-safe-data-testspec/group__safe__data.html#ga21a7a26ee6df4663d818734e2372a72e>`__
TC_SAFE_DATA_UPDATE_CLAMPS_POSITIVE_MUTA.title: update clamps positive mutator return

TC_SAFE_DATA_UPDATE_COMMITS.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

Update commits a mutator transaction.

SAFE_UPDATE runs the mutator under the lock and reseals on a zero return; the committed value is visible to the next read.

**Source:** `main.c (line 125) <../../dox-safe-data-testspec/group__safe__data.html#gac032958aa2b97cbda5eb6163dcb22013>`__
TC_SAFE_DATA_UPDATE_COMMITS.title: update commits

verify_repair restores the payload in place

`safe_data_verify_repair() <../../dox-safe-data-api/group__safe__data__core__apis.html#ga08da109c60349a5bd8f6fbe8af830704>`__ (lock-held contract) restores a corrupted payload from the shadow copy in place; the container verifies clean afterwards.

.. rst-class:: need-brief

Write observes corruption before overwriting.

With CONFIG_SAFE_DATA_WRITE_CHECKS_OLD a write over corrupted contents still succeeds, but the destroyed evidence is counted in the statistics first.

**Depends on:** ``CONFIG_SAFE_DATA_WRITE_CHECKS_OLD``; ``CONFIG_SAFE_DATA_STATS``

TC_SAFE_DATA_WRITE_RESEALS.content:
.. rst-class:: need-brief

Write replaces the payload and reseals.

After SAFE_WRITE the container verifies clean and a subsequent read returns the new value: the tag can never go stale across a write.

Status obsolete (demonstration of status handling): superseded by TC_SAFE_DATA_READ_ROUNDTRIP, which checks the resealed write through a validated read. The test still runs.
